SITE INFORMATION

Privacy policy

Last updated: 14 October 2026

This policy describes information handled through Ranveer Sangwan’s personal portfolio. For privacy enquiries, contact ranveersangwan22@gmail.com.

Contact form information

If you use the contact form, you provide your name, email address, subject, and message. These details are sent through EmailJS and the connected email provider to my inbox so I can read and respond to your enquiry. Please avoid sending passwords, payment details, or other sensitive information.

How information is used

I use contact details and messages to respond to enquiries, discuss projects or opportunities, and maintain relevant correspondence. The form does not subscribe you to a mailing list. I do not sell contact form information.

Hosting and service providers

This portfolio is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub states that it logs visitor IP addresses for security purposes. EmailJS and the connected email provider process contact submissions and may retain service logs or message records under their own policies.

  • GitHub Pages data collection
  • GitHub privacy statement
  • EmailJS privacy policy

Cookies and analytics

The portfolio source does not add advertising trackers, analytics scripts, or cookies. Hosting and external services have their own data practices. Links to GitHub, LinkedIn, and project demos take you to third-party sites covered by their own policies.

Retention and requests

Messages may remain in my mailbox and service records until deleted. To request access, correction, or deletion of information you sent through the form, email me from the address used in your enquiry. Requests concerning records controlled by GitHub, EmailJS, or your email provider may also need to be directed to that provider.

Policy changes

This page will be updated when the site’s data handling changes. The date above identifies the latest revision.
